job.title: Skilled Labourer
job.description:
At Network Recruitment Group, we specialise in connecting skilled construction professionals with some of Perth's leading commercial construction companies. We offer exciting opportunities to work on high-profile commercial projects across the Perth metropolitan area, with ongoing work and temporary assignments available throughout the year.

We are currently seeking experienced and reliable Construction Labourers for a variety of commercial projects across the Perth metro area (NO FIFO). Both short-term and long-term positions are available, with immediate starts for the right candidates.

You will have:
  • Construction White Card (essential)
  • Commercial construction experience (essential)
  • The ability to work in fast paced and high-risk environments
  • Flexibility in terms of work responsibilities, roles and working hours
  • A positive attitude with a great work ethic
  • Reliable and self-motivated
  • Ability to pass a drug and alcohol test
  • Police Clearance - National/International (beneficial)
  • Extra qualifications are highly regarded; these may include:
    • Hoist Operation - (Personnel and Materials)
    • Telehandler
    • Dogman
    • Tower Crane Operators
    • Traffic Control (BWTM and TC)
    • C class Driving license and car
Benefits:
  • Paid Weekly
  • Career growth opportunities with reputable companies in the industry
  • Positions available NOR and SOR
  • Casual and Ongoing positions available!
If the above sounds like you and you are interested in the work we have available please click APPLY NOW! If you have any questions please call us on 08 9380 9727.

job.title: Dogman
job.description:
The team at Network Recruitment Group specialise in placing skilled, motivated and upstanding construction workers on commercial construction projects across the Perth metropolitan area and greater Western Australia. 

We are currently looking for experienced Dogmen to be part of the tower crane crew for long-term and short term projects starting up.

These roles offer the opportunity to work on prominent construction projects with well-established commercial builders.

You will have the following:
  • Experience dogging tower cranes on commercial construction projects
  • Ability to communicate clearly with partnered crane operator
  • Current High-Risk Licence with either: DG / RB / RI / RA
  • Tower Crane licence highly desirable
  • White Card
  • Available to work Monday through to Saturday
  • A good level of physical fitness
  • The ability to pass random drug & alcohol test
If you meet the above requirements and wish to be considered for these roles, hit the "APPLY" button now and upload your up to date resume. 
For more information please contact us on 08 9380 9727.

job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
Due to our success and an array of new projects an opportunity is now available for an experienced Recruitment Consultant to join our fast-paced team based in East Perth.

The Role:
As a Recruitment Consultant you will take pride in providing a high-level service and ensure we recruit the right people for our valued clients.
Working a long side a supportive and bubbly team, you will source and place candidates in a fast paced environment.
You will be provided with full, and ongoing training both internally and externally with on the job support at all times.
To be considered for this position, you will have the following:
  • Experience/knowledge within recruitment, construction industry knowledge will be highly regarded, but not completely essential.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced environment
  • Excellent communication skills and innovative attitude 
  • Strong time management skills
  • Strong ability to build and maintain candidate and client relationship
  • Enjoy a work hard, play hard setting
  • You will be resilient and determined with a “can do” attitude
Why Network Recruitment group
Our people are everything to us! We look for positive, motivated and like-minded professionals who are not afraid of hard work and can have a lot of fun in the process. Our teams consist of high achievers, people who love coming to work, love what they do and put everything into it.
You will be fully supported and given training as required along with the opportunity to grow and develop a career.
Be rewarded with casual Fridays, staff/team building events, excellent location, great earning potential and MORE!
If you are interested in joining our team please click the "APPLY" button now, and upload your application. If you require further information please call Alice Dodgson on 9380 9727.
